reason: API 2.0 Beta (https://www.v2ex.com/help/api, re-opened 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium; the page is server-rendered and identical to the plain fetch) documents paths and the PAT header (Authorization: Bearer; GET nodes/:node_name/topics?p=, topics/:topic_id, topics/:topic_id/replies, member, token, notifications; 600 requests/hour per IP) but gives only request examples, no response bodies or field names, and without a token the API answers {"message": "Token not found", "success": false}. Topic fields (title/content/member/created) cannot be cited, so nothing is mapped; there is also no reply/message write endpoint and no search.
